M1.detail: SET stores key-value pair and returns OK

M2.detail: GET returns value or ERR key_not_found (handles expired keys)

M3.detail: DEL removes key and returns OK, or ERR key_not_found

M4.detail: KEYS lists keys one per line terminated by END

M7.detail: FLUSH clears all keys and returns OK

M8.detail: OK returned for successful SET and DEL

M10.detail: Keys > 64 chars rejected with ERR key_too_long

M11.detail: Values > 1024 UTF-8 bytes rejected with ERR value_too_large

M12.detail: Store at 100 keys rejects new SET with ERR store_full; updates allowed

S1.detail: MSET atomically sets multiple pairs under lock, returns OK <n>

S2.detail: MGET returns values/NIL one per line terminated by END

S3.detail: TTL returns remaining seconds, -1 for no expiry, ERR key_not_found

S4.detail: SETEX sets key with TTL; expired keys treated as non-existent

S5.detail: APPEND appends or creates key, returns OK <new_length> in UTF-8 bytes

Y1.detail: RENAME renames key, preserves expiry, returns OK or ERR key_not_found

Y2.detail: TYPE returns STRING or INTEGER based on value parsing

Y3.detail: DUMP returns key=value lines terminated by END
